create.description: Every purchase, every enrolment and every change to who your children play with asks for this PIN first. Only you know it, so nothing on this account can be bought or changed without you.

unlock.title: Enter your parent PIN
unlock.description: Purchases and changes to your children’s accounts are gated behind this PIN, so only you can make them.

mismatch: Those PINs didn’t match. Let’s try again.

forgotSent.title: Check your email
forgotSent.description: If your account has an email on file, we’ve sent a link to reset your PIN. The link expires in 24 hours.

reset.description: Set a new 4-digit PIN that only you know.
reset.successDescription: Your parent PIN has been updated. Sign in and enter it to continue.
reset.invalidDescription: This PIN reset link is invalid or has expired. Sign in and request a new one.

change.successDescription: Your parent PIN has been changed.
